verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Sentry's core is open source, letting developers inspect code to build custom integrations without relying on official docs (sentry-comm-1), and self-hosting is documented, but there is no explicit ingestion protocol/envelope spec, no OpenAPI ingest schema (probe found only 404s), and no third-party or community example of a custom client successfully sending events without an official SDK. missing for 10: explicit ingestion protocol documentation (event/envelope format spec), a published API/OpenAPI schema for ingest, and independent evidence of a non-official SDK/client successfully sending events.
